Metrics definitions for Firedancer tiles, enums, counters, gauges, and histograms.

# Purpose
This XML file defines the full metrics schema used by Firedancer for telemetry and monitoring. It groups metrics by tile, such as `net`, `quic`, `pack`, `bank`, `gossip`, and `snapin`, and it declares counters, gauges, and histograms with names, summaries, units, and enum bindings. It also defines many enums that map metric values to named states and error results, which lets the monitoring system report structured status data instead of raw numbers. The file serves as the source of truth for metric names and value sets, and it includes a compatibility rule that existing metric names must not change.
